title: Undo after a drag puts a shape back where it was, even with Position and Size open
goal: With the Position and Size popover open, dragging a shape and pressing Undo does not put it back where it started: the first Undo stops at a spot the shape passed through during the drag, and a second Undo is needed. A person expects one drag to be one undo.
notes: Found 2026-09-26 while reproducing a-rotated-shape-keeps-its-rotation-when-you-move (unrelated to rotation). Repro walk (/tmp/rotrepro/pop.json): blank 900x600, rectangle tool drag (120,120)->(320,220), select tool, action positionAndSize (firstResponder becomes _SystemTextFieldFieldEditor), drag body (220,170)->(320,250), undo, undo. Tree readings: after drag (220,200); after first undo (120,128); after second undo (120,120). So the drag made two history steps: a move to (120,128) and then the drag. Theory (not confirmed): the focused X/Y field commits the live preview value (previewMoves) when it loses first responder part way into the drag. Without the popover open the same drag undoes in one step to (120,120).
acceptance: With Position and Size open, one drag of a shape followed by one Undo returns it exactly to where it started
The drag leaves exactly one step in the undo history
A walk opens Position and Size, drags a shape, undoes once and shows it back at its starting place

log.note: Reproduced with /tmp/rotrepro/pop.json: after the drag (220,200); first undo (120,128); second (120,120). Cause: the X box had the keyboard with the draft '120' and stopped following the moving shape. The canvas took the keyboard, the box let go one step into the drag, and landDraft put X=120 onto the PREVIEW frame (130,128). That made (120,128) an undo step of its own.

Fix: NumberBox.landing takes 'offered' (core, tested first): a draft still reading what the box put there itself lands nothing. PanelNumberField records it via offer(). Second case found while testing: 300 typed into X, then a drag, gave (300,128) and then (220,200), so the number was lost and it took two undos. Now NumberFieldDraft lets CanvasNSView.mouseDown land a typed draft first; that press is swallowed (same rule as the inline text editor), because the canvas still hit-tests its old copy of the document.

Verified: new walk undo-after-a-drag-with-position-and-size-open-walk passes and FAILS on the old code (Y reads 128). 28 walks that type into number boxes pass on the fixed probe. Scripts/test.sh: 10253 tests pass. Rough item (first press only lands a typed number, no drag) went into the audit's rough list, not filed: nothing is lost and it matches the canvas's existing commit-then-swallow rule.

With Position and Size open, one drag and one Undo put the shape back exactly where it started, and the drag is one history step. A typed number that was never sent now lands on the next canvas press instead of being lost. Fix is in NumberBox.landing(offered:), PanelNumberField and NumberFieldDraft (CanvasPointerDrags). New walk undo-after-a-drag-with-position-and-size-open-walk passes and fails on the old code. 28 walks that type into number boxes pass. Scripts/test.sh passes (10253 tests). Commit 27f6d57a.
